p.i: paucis turgatum. Summæ meæ ergā te obseruantiæ testem perpetuum, ac pignus certissimum tibi exhibeo. Tu, pro comitate tua, quicquid est, quantillum est, benigne ut recipias mihiq; porrò fauëas [?], etiam atque etiam te oro. Deus te Ecclesiæ ac Reipublicæ Christianæ diu seruet incolumem. Tiguri Helvet. KL. Ianuariis anni nouï [?] M.DC.X.

page.notes: The printed ornament below the text is a woodcut vignette, not transcribed. The "u" in "nouï" is damaged by a stain near the line end, so the reading is uncertain. "fauëas" has a damaged letter before "as"; the reading is uncertain. The line "paucis turgatum" is partly rubbed at its start.
